mapper.select: SELECT periodid, branchid, mode, title, startdate, enddate FROM ttokssaemdb.timetable_period WHERE useyn = 'Y' AND #{plandate} BETWEEN startdate AND enddate AND branchid IN ('ALL', #{branchid}) ORDER BY (branchid = 'ALL') ASC, periodid DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT mode, class, code, label, shortlabel, timetext FROM ttokssaemdb.timetable_slot WHERE mode = #{mode} ORDER BY class ASC
